notes.title: Version 1.07 Released
notes.notes:
This update removes any issues with pipes not snapping when they seemingly should, as well as make it easier to detect when snapping will occur.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed pipes sometimes dropping when they should have snapped.
[*]Enlarged the snapping trigger.
[*]Added Haptics when in range of a snap. (Should also help blind placement!)
[/list]

If you experience any bugs and issues, [b]please let us know[/b] in the "Bugs and Technical Issues" section of the discussion board.
We are only a small team but we want to help solve problems as fast as possible! So any feedback is incredibly helpful.

Also feel free to contact us to give feedback or drop a review.

Happy Plumbing!

The Everwake Team

notes.title: Smooth Locomotion Update!
notes.notes:
With the new locomotion settings, you can now move around and smooth/snap turn via joysticks. 
Useful for those with a less than minimum playspace.

[b]Where can I find this setting?[/b]
Locomotion can be found via the new "Locomotion Settings" button within the newspaper settings page. Here you can choose to turn smooth locomotion on and off, pick smooth or snap turning, as well as the angle of your snap turn.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/cbce4c1b8a3c3d32d1be02bcb9fb18150be1c3cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047637/ce0b102bc0b7dfa7abd4e8d0f53cb8ac61c82b09.png[/img]


[b]Why was this added now?[/b]
Pipeline VR is at its heart and design a roomscale game, so we were initially hesitant in adding this feature as we felt it could reduce the hectic fun a roomscale game brings. However, we know that sometimes options are good and wanted to be sure that players can play their way. After hearing feedback, we knew it was time to give the option.

[b]What is the new minimum playspace?[/b]
While we can't give an exact measurement, you will still need enough space to physically crouch and move your arms.

[b]I have another feature request![/b]
Great!, let us know what it is. We love to hear your ideas.

This method of movement is currently experimental, so we would love to hear opinions and feedback. So please get in touch and let us know what you think!

Happy Plumbing!
The Everwake Team
